devflowVersion.description: The plugin version the installed templates came from. Written by /devflow:init, updated by /devflow:init --upgrade.

remote.description: Git remote that points at GitHub.

baseBranch.description: Branches start from <remote>/<baseBranch>; PRs target it.

protectedBranches.description: The guard hook blocks pushes to these and to baseBranch.

devflow.description: Put on every PR devflow opens; /devflow:sync targets PRs with it.

riskLow.description: Issue/PR label: eligible for the merge gate.

riskHigh.description: Issue/PR label: waits for a human merge.

stacked.description: PR label: the PR is based on another open devflow PR.

triage.description: Issue label for bugs and gaps no human has triaged yet. /devflow:next-task never picks them; only a human replaces it with the ready label.

priority.description: Priority labels, highest first. No label counts as the entry ending in "normal". Changes only the order of /devflow:next-task and the merge gate, never who merges.

risk.description: How /devflow:spec and next-task judge whether a change needs a human merge. Unsure means high.

default: data migration or deleting stored data
a change to a public API contract that breaks existing clients
highWhen.description: Plain-language conditions; a task matching any is risk:high.

highPaths.description: Globs (** * ?). A PR touching a matching file is escalated to risk:high before it is opened.

mergeGate.description: Read by the devflow merge gate GitHub Action. Claude itself never merges.

dryRun.description: Log what would be merged without merging.

requiredChecks.description: Names of check runs or commit-status contexts that must be green before the gate merges.

method.description: Merge commits are required for stacked PRs.

e2eFramework.description: True when the project has an automated e2e/browser test setup that can hold committed e2e tests. When false, e2e test rows are covered by the verify stage only.

checks.description: Run in order; all must pass before review.

format.description: Formatters the plugin runs after Claude writes or edits a file: glob -> shell command; {file} is the shell-quoted path relative to the project root (appended when missing). A glob without "/" matches the file name in any directory. Quiet; never fails the edit. Example: {"*.py": ".venv/bin/ruff format {file}"}.

lock.description: Only one session at a time runs Verify on this machine (a lock under the git common dir), so parallel lanes do not fight over the dev server port.

testMatrix.description: Run the QA step in /devflow:spec: an agent drafts a test matrix from the acceptance criteria and reports criteria it cannot test.

qaModel.description: Model for the QA agent. Opus is better at spotting untestable criteria and cases the spec leaves out; Sonnet is cheaper.

parallelQa.description: Implement runs a QA agent (acceptance tests from the spec and issue only) in parallel with the dev agent when the plan names test files for the issue's Test cases rows. false: one agent writes the test first, then the implementation.

reviewerAgent.description: Subagent type the Review stage runs as (the plugin ships devflow:reviewer). Empty string: the default workflow agent. Falls back to the default agent when the type cannot be started.

worktree.description: Isolated runs (/devflow:next-task --isolated, /devflow:dispatch): each ticket gets its own git worktree.

dir.description: Directory (relative to the repository root) that holds the worktrees. Keep it in .gitignore.

setup.description: Commands run once in a fresh worktree before any work, e.g. "make setup" or "npm ci".

dispatch.description: Read by /devflow:dispatch, which starts one background Claude session per lane.

maxLanes.description: Most background sessions running at the same time.

pluginDir.description: Passed as --plugin-dir to background sessions when the plugin is loaded from a local directory. Omit when it is installed from a marketplace.

ignoreHotspots.description: Hotspots matching these exact paths (or globs with * and **) do not join lanes: conflicts there are small and resolved by the merge gate's branch update or /devflow:sync.

scan.description: Read by the weakened-checks scan of the Review stage (bin/devflow-scan).

ignore.description: Globs (** * ?, like risk.highPaths) of files the scan skips entirely, e.g. a test file whose fixture data holds the scanned patterns. .claude/devflow.json is never ignored, so an edit to this list is itself a scan hit (and a high-risk path at the merge gate).

notify.description: Push notifications (Claude Code PushNotification tool) from runs.

push.description: Send a push notification when a run ends with a blocked issue, a risk:high PR waiting for a human, or at the end of a lane.

onDone.description: Notify at the end of a lane or run.

onBlocked.description: Notify when an issue is blocked.

onHighRisk.description: Notify when a risk:high PR waits for a human.

draft.description: Create the GitHub release as a draft; a human publishes it.

deploy.description: Optional shell command run after the release, only after the user says yes. Empty: none.

notesFrom.description: Where the release notes come from: the merged PRs since the last tag.

labels.description: Extra labels on the gap issues it files.
